title: AgentCraft Toolkit Index
description: Schema for validating TOOLKIT_INDEX(1).json before the G02 audit consumes it. Per START_HERE_GLM.md §6: 'The index is discovery evidence, not proof of runtime fitness.' This schema only validates STRUCTURE — runtime fitness is verified separately by scripts/verify_tool_imports.py.

generated_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the inventory was generated.

source.description: Optional: where the inventory came from (path / URL).

categories.description: Map of category name → list of tools in that category.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the category.

total_tools.description: Optional: total count of tools across all categories.

name.description: Canonical tool name (import name or pip package).

version.description: Declared version (may differ from installed version — audit verifies).

category.description: Capability domain: discovery | acquisition | crawling | browser | extraction | scientific | social | provenance | other.

pypi.description: PyPI package name if installed via pip.

supported_sources.description: Source types this tool supports (web, arxiv, github, rss, etc.).
